Gain the corresponding placement bonus immediately when its space is covered, once only; if several bonus spaces are covered, gain each corresponding bonus. When building multiple buildings, resolve the first building placement bonuses before placing the next building.

grades.question: How are the starting player and ordinary turn sequence determined, does play use formal rounds, and how many regular actions do you take on a turn before resolving any additional effects or bonuses?

expected.expected_answer: Randomly determine the starting player. Normal turns proceed clockwise. Ark Nova has no formal rounds: players take one turn at a time until game end is triggered, with breaks interrupting play as required. On an ordinary turn perform one action, which may trigger additional effects or bonuses.
